info.title: OSRIP API
info.description: Oman Smart Resource Intelligence Platform - academic prototype. Not an official statistical service.

get.description:
Development and tests only: codes 'sent' by the scripted test provider. 404 in
production and whenever another provider is configured.

schema.title: Response Sms Outbox Api V1 Dev Sms Outbox Get

get.description: Development only: messages stored instead of sent. 404 in any other configuration.

schema.title: Response Outbox Api V1 Dev Outbox Get

get.description: Process liveness only; says nothing about the database.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description: Database reachability. Errors are mapped to a stable 503 by the app handler.

schema.title: Response Health Db Api V1 Health Db Get

get.description: Readiness for load balancers: database reachable and migration version. 503 if not.

schema.title: Response Ready Api V1 Health Ready Get

post.description: Browser error report. No cookies or identity used; limited per client address.

schema.title: Response Monitoring View Api V1 Admin Monitoring Get

get.description:
AI and search providers: configured, tested, unavailable or failed, which role each
plays, today's calls and limits. Names of missing settings only, never values.

schema.title: Response Provider Readiness Api V1 Admin Providers Get

post.description:
One minimal live call to check a provider really works (it may cost a little), so it
needs an administrator (``user.manage``) besides the read permission of the view.

schema.title: Response Provider Test Api V1 Admin Providers  Name  Test Post

get.description: Booklet Table 3.5: public definitions and compatible units.

schema.title: Response List Indicators Api V1 Indicators Get

get.description: Which sign-in methods this server offers. Unconfigured ones are reported, not faked.

schema.title: Response Providers Api V1 Auth Providers Get

post.description:
The signed-in user sets a new password (required after a temporary one). Other
sessions of the account are signed out.
Creates an unverified account with ordinary (viewer) access and sends a link.

schema.title: Response Register Api V1 Auth Register Post
Response Verify Email Api V1 Auth Verify Email Post
Response Resend Api V1 Auth Verify Email Resend Post
Response Forgot Api V1 Auth Password Forgot Post

post.description: Sets a new password, revokes every existing session and marks the address verified.

schema.title: Response Reset Api V1 Auth Password Reset Post
Response Magic Link Api V1 Auth Magic Link Post

post.description:
Sends a code by SMS. Returns an opaque challenge id, never the code. The answer is
the same whether or not the number already has an account.

schema.title: Response Phone Request Api V1 Auth Phone Request Post

post.description:
Checks the code. Signs in (creating an ordinary account for a new number), or
links the number to the signed-in account.

schema.title: Response Phone Verify Api V1 Auth Phone Verify Post

post.description: Adds an e-mail address to the signed-in account once the link sent to it is opened.

schema.title: Response Email Link Api V1 Auth Email Link Post
Response Email Link Confirm Api V1 Auth Email Link Confirm Post
Response List Identities Api V1 Auth Identities Get
Response List Users Api V1 Admin Users Get
Response Audit Events Api V1 Admin Audit Events Get

get.description: Public: sources with a published or superseded version. Import readers also see drafts.

schema.title: Response List Sources Api V1 Sources Get
Response List Imports Api V1 Imports Get

get.description: Error preview: every row with its outcome, original values and reasons.
Downloadable error list: row number, original value and reason (booklet 3.3).

Observations with unit, period, geography, data mode and source version.

``data_mode`` is required. Without ``dataset_version_id`` each source
contributes its one published snapshot.

parameters.name: period_kind

schema.description: Complete years, year-to-date totals, quarters, months or dated statements
schema.title: Period Kind

parameters.description: Complete years, year-to-date totals, quarters, months or dated statements

schema.title: Response Observations Api V1 Observations Get

get.description:
CSV export with provenance, and the mode in the metadata lines and the file name.

Missing values stay empty cells.

parameters.name: period_kind

schema.description: Complete years, year-to-date totals, quarters, months or dated statements
schema.title: Period Kind

parameters.description: Complete years, year-to-date totals, quarters, months or dated statements

get.description: The shared registry. Synthetic-only commodities appear in synthetic mode only.

schema.title: Response Commodities Api V1 Commodities Get

get.description:
Rows in time order for the view (monthly, quarterly or annual): published values,
periods derived from complete published components by the indicator's value type, and
missing periods left empty; year-to-date totals apart; changes from the previous period
and the same period a year earlier; every row with its source.

schema.title: Response Series Timeline Api V1 Series Timeline Get

get.description: The same rows as the table and the chart, with provenance, as CSV.

Governorates and wilayats with names, parents, identifiers, verification and references.

Registry coverage only: listing an area says nothing about whether data exists for it.

schema.title: Response Areas Api V1 Areas Get

get.description:
Statistical coverage: published observations recorded for each exact area.

Areas without observations are absent (shown as "No data", never zero).

schema.title: Response Area Coverage Api V1 Areas Coverage Get

get.description:
The latest loaded pack with every reference (including crosschecks that supply no
imported value), its documented conflicts and limitations, and how many of its records
are published. ``pack`` is null when no pack has been loaded.

schema.title: Response Reference Pack Api V1 Reference Pack Get

post.description:
Run and store an analysis for one sector (parameters: sector, area, period_kind, and an
optional scenario: supply_growth_pct, demand_growth_pct, years).

schema.title: Response Run Api V1 Analysis Balance Post

post.description: The same validated analysis, computed but not stored.

schema.title: Response Preview Api V1 Analysis Balance Preview Post
Response Get Api V1 Analysis Balance  Analysis Id  Get

get.description:
The exact words the voice reads for this analysis (the transcript shown beside the
player): its summary and each balance's status, not every table cell.

schema.title: Response Spoken Api V1 Analysis Balance  Analysis Id  Spoken Get
Response Reproduce Api V1 Analysis Balance  Analysis Id  Reproduce Get

get.description: A readable, printable report of the stored analysis (no scripts; values escaped).
Public: transparent calculations over the published snapshot of one data mode.

schema.title: Response Section Analysis Api V1 Analysis  Section  Get
Response Run Rules Api V1 Analysis Runs Post

get.description: Public: review cards of the latest rule run for the data mode, with their current status.

schema.title: Response Recommendations Api V1 Recommendations Get

get.description: Review notes are protected (booklet 3.15): analysts and reviewers only.

schema.title: Response Reviews Api V1 Recommendations  Recommendation Id  Reviews Get
Response Add Review Api V1 Recommendations  Recommendation Id  Reviews Post

get.description: Public: which published series could support the experiment, and why not.

schema.title: Response Eligibility Api V1 Forecast Eligibility Get

post.description: Record an experiment. An ineligible series is recorded as withheld, with its reasons.

schema.title: Response Run Api V1 Forecast Runs Post
Response Runs Api V1 Forecast Runs Get
Response Run Detail Api V1 Forecast Runs  Run Id  Get

get.description: Public: each target indicator with its series, eligibility and latest forecast run.

schema.title: Response Forecast Overview Api V1 Forecast Overview Get

get.description:
Public: candidate development conditions per domain, each marked measured (a published
compatible series exists) or a scenario assumption, with the evidence still needed.

schema.title: Response Forecast Conditions Api V1 Forecast Conditions Get

get.description: Public: series with a complete published value that a scenario can start from.

schema.title: Response Scenario Series Api V1 Scenarios Series Get

get.description: Public: a hypothetical scenario (not a forecast) from the latest published value.

schema.title: Response Scenario Projection Api V1 Scenarios Projection Get

get.description: Public: whether the assistant is configured, its limits and suggested questions.

schema.title: Response Assistant Status Api V1 Assistant Status Get

get.description:
Public, read-only: the active version of the assistant's identity, personas and
approved project knowledge. There is deliberately no write route; new versions are
published by an operator (``python -m app.cli assistant-profile publish FILE``).

schema.title: Response Assistant Profile Api V1 Assistant Profile Get

get.description:
The signed-in person's saved persona (null: the default). Visitors without an account
keep their choice in this browser only, so nothing is stored for them here.

schema.title: Response Persona Choice Api V1 Assistant Persona Get

put.description:
Save the signed-in person's persona (a preference: it changes who speaks, never the
knowledge, tools, permissions, sources, history or limits).

schema.title: Response Save Persona Choice Api V1 Assistant Persona Put
Response Conversations Api V1 Assistant Conversations Get
Response Create Api V1 Assistant Conversations Post

delete.description: Delete every conversation of the signed-in user (saved research is kept separately).

schema.title: Response Delete All Api V1 Assistant Conversations Delete
Response Conversation Api V1 Assistant Conversations  Conversation Id  Get
Response Ask Api V1 Assistant Conversations  Conversation Id  Messages Post

get.description: The stages reached so far by one of the caller's questions (polled while it runs).

schema.title: Response Request Progress Api V1 Assistant Requests  Request Id  Progress Get

post.description: Stop one of the caller's running questions; it ends unanswered and is not counted.

schema.title: Response Cancel Request Api V1 Assistant Requests  Request Id  Cancel Post

get.description:
The live study of one of the caller's questions, as server-sent events (another
person's request is never found: its stream ends at once with ``end``).
Every event of one of the caller's studies, to return to it later.

schema.title: Response Request Study Api V1 Assistant Requests  Request Id  Study Get

get.description: What Al Mulhim keeps for this account, by kind, with the retention rule.

schema.title: Response Memory Api V1 Assistant Memory Get

get.description:
The visitor's guest allowance, issuing the anonymous cookie on first use. Signed-in
users get ``authenticated: true`` and whether guest history can be linked.

schema.title: Response Guest Status Api V1 Assistant Guest Get
Response Guest Conversation Api V1 Assistant Guest Conversations  Conversation Id  Get

delete.description:
A guest deletes one of this browser's conversations. The allowance already used is
unchanged (deleting history never returns answers).

schema.title: Response Guest Request Progress Api V1 Assistant Guest Requests  Request Id  Progress Get

get.description: A guest's live study, as server-sent events (this browser's requests only).

schema.title: Response Guest Request Study Api V1 Assistant Guest Requests  Request Id  Study Get

post.description: A guest stops a running question: it is not counted against the allowance.

schema.title: Response Guest Cancel Request Api V1 Assistant Guest Requests  Request Id  Cancel Post
Response Guest Ask Api V1 Assistant Guest Messages Post

get.description:
Public: whether server speech is configured, each persona's configured voice per
language, and the limits (no secrets).

schema.title: Response Voice Status Api V1 Assistant Voice Get

post.description:
Speech to text for one question (WAV PCM 16 kHz mono). The audio is not stored;
the text is returned for the user to review before anything is asked.

schema.title: Response Voice Transcribe Api V1 Assistant Voice Transcribe Post

post.description: Text to speech of an assistant reply the caller owns (not arbitrary text).

get.description:
Public: each persona's configured voice per language and whether the speech service
lists it (``verified``: true, false, or null when it cannot be checked). English is read
only by English voices; nothing assumes an Arabic voice speaks English.

schema.title: Response Voice Voices Api V1 Assistant Voice Voices Get

post.description:
A fixed sample sentence (with a number and a unit) in the chosen persona's configured
voice, so the person can hear it before relying on it. Not arbitrary text.

A concise spoken explanation of a stored shortage and surplus analysis (its summary
and each balance's status, not every table cell), in the chosen persona's voice.

get.description:
Public: whether real-time voice (LiveKit) is ready, and which settings are missing
(names only). Without it, Talk uses push-to-talk with a still portrait.

schema.title: Response Voice Realtime Status Api V1 Assistant Voice Realtime Get

post.description:
A short-lived token for one new LiveKit room. The participant identity is set here
(account or guest session), so the agent charges answers to the right allowance; guests
who have used their five answers are asked to sign in first. The chosen persona decides
the agent's voice and avatar for the call.

schema.title: Response Voice Realtime Session Api V1 Assistant Voice Realtime Session Post

post.description:
End call: the caller's room is deleted on the media server, which disconnects the
agent and any avatar worker immediately, so no paid session keeps running.

schema.title: Response Voice Realtime End Api V1 Assistant Voice Realtime End Post

post.description: Explicitly moves this browser's guest conversations into the signed-in account.

schema.title: Response Guest Link Api V1 Assistant Guest Link Post

DataMode.title: DataMode
DataMode.description: Booklet 3.4: two explicitly separate modes. Never mixed in one query.

DatasetVersionStatus.title: DatasetVersionStatus
DatasetVersionStatus.description: Also the import lifecycle: draft (uploaded) -> validated -> approved -> published.

Frequency.title: Frequency
Frequency.description: Observation frequency; periods must match it (migration 0003 CHECK).

LocatorKind.title: LocatorKind
LocatorKind.description: What a source URL points at. A catalogue page cannot verify an observation.

Permission.title: Permission
Permission.description: Server-side permission codes (migration 0003 seeds the same codes).

PhysicalDimension.title: PhysicalDimension
PhysicalDimension.description: Unit conversion is permitted only within one dimension (booklet 3.5).

ValueType.title: ValueType
ValueType.description: How an observation relates to its period; governs aggregation (3.3).
